_about: Livy in English: the Bohn translation, complete across four Gutenberg texts (D. Spillan, Cyrus Edmonds, W. A. McDevitte; Books I-VIII, IX-XXVI, XXVII-XXXVI, XXXVII to the end with the Epitomes and fragments). Also Church and Brodribb's Books I-III (ed. Osborne). Latin-facing Loebs of 1930 or earlier added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row); the scan's printing was checked for a post-1930 revision notice where its title verso survives. Older translations from the wishlist added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row). Perseus TEI English (section "perseus", fetched by pipeline/fetch_perseus.py): translations published in or before 1930; the TEI markup is Perseus Digital Library's, CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution + share-alike), recorded per file in the report.
